faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 21st September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th in science, possess a Diploma in MLT/DMLT, and have at least 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Laboratory Technician post is 30 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Laboratory Technician position at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Laboratory Technician Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Laboratory Technician role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Laboratory Technician position will be as per Ayush Rules.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Laboratory Technician post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is advisable to read it thoroughly before applying.
